text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This G1 race will determine the Classics'
king of
the mile. Data must be properly
taken.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon mutters to herself.
Before she
goes off for the race, there's
something I've been
meaning to ask her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I just thought... you were running... a
little
different than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To this day, I still have no idea what
Manhattan
Cafe meant back then when
she said Tachyon's
running looked
different.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there! Again with that topic? As I
said
before, Cafe was just imagining
things.
choice_data_list: 君の『走り方』は、どう変わったんだ？
貴方の『走り方』は、どう変わったの？

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even if she wasn't, the fact that
I haven't
said anything about it means it
isn't yet the time
to do so.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What ought to concern you as my trainer
is how
well I might run today. Nothing
more and nothing
less.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What significance does any other matter
have
right now, besides serving as a
distraction?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her posture speaks for the sincerity of
her
question. I'm not sure how to
respond.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If it lacks significance—No. Even if it has

significance, this conversation is
off-limits for the
time being, all right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now, the race should be beginning soon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she leaves the waiting room
without
further explanation.
